name: Bodies Actors
operation_language: Authoring declarations only; not registered engine opcodes.

authored_operations.requirement: Reuse creature selectors and actor candidates. Bind exact remains/body identity, creature type/size, age of death, preservation, knowledge, gear, consumed/reanimated state and ownership. Carry created actors, commands, control/appearance lifetimes, death, legal arrivals and temporary equipment through room/combat transitions without respawning or paying loot.

blockers: Campaign guard bones and event traveler prose lack some life/death/knowledge facts. Do not infer a valid Revivify target or fabricate corpse answers. Created undead equipment, temporary steed tack and campaign finale Rejuvenation policy retain creature-pass blockers.
reuse_boundary: Existing accepted pieces remain accepted at their documented limits; these requirements do not mark the entire slices missing.
